summary_en: Year-end dividend raised 2.00 yen to 54.00 yen/share (FY12/26). Annual dividend now 106.00 yen/share vs. 104.00 yen prior forecast. Revision driven by upward earnings forecast and commitment to progressive dividend policy with ~40% payout ratio under medium-term plan (FY25–27).
title_en: Notice of Revision to Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Hike)
translation_en_brief: Ryobi Limited announced on 5 August 2026 a revision to its FY12/26 year-end dividend forecast. The year-end dividend per share is raised by 2.00 yen from the prior forecast to 54.00 yen/share, bringing the full-year dividend to 106.00 yen/share (vs. 104.00 yen previously forecast and 100.00 yen in FY12/25). The revision reflects an upward revision to the full-year earnings forecast announced on the same date. The company operates under a medium-term plan (FY2025–27) targeting progressive dividends with a payout ratio guideline of approximately 40%. The company intends to continue executing enhanced shareholder returns within this framework.
